description: Co. Kerry Road Network is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kerry County Council. This dataset contains the Road Network for Kerry County Council. The Roads were originally digitised against OSi 50000 Discovery raster Mapping using MapInfo and are continuously maintained and updated. Coverage: Kerry County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Kerry County Council. Its tags are kerry, road, road network, traffic infrastructure, transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
